parsed.rationale: Both participating records in this cluster have is_test=true and reside in the same test file, Shared/Playlist/Tests/PlaylistTests/PlaylistAPIVersionTests.swift. The two methods — invalidFeatureFlagFallsBackToDefault (line 108) and nonStringFeatureFlagFallsBackToDefault (line 122) — are distinct test cases that exercise semantically different invalid-input scenarios (an invalid feature flag type vs. a non-string feature flag type), even if their structural shape is similar (Jaccard 0.78). Collapsing them into a single generic test function would obscure the intent of each scenario and reduce test readability and failure diagnostics. Per the decision rules, all-test clusters are classified as intentional duplication.
